tasks.title: Write an Email
tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt: You are a student who lives in a dormitory on campus and have noticed that the communal laundry room has some issues. You want to address these concerns with the head of campus maintenance, Ms. Roberts. Write an email to Ms. Roberts.
bullets: Describe the issues in the laundry room.
Explain how the issues affect students.
Suggest ways to improve maintenance and cleanliness.
tasks.subject: Concerns About Communal Laundry Room
